Voted one of the TOP 10 places to visit with your family in NJ, we are located in Mays Landing, NJ. Admission and parking are FREE. We are open year round on Sundays and Tuesdays only from 8-4pm. 

We are a Family-Friendly Animal Rescue & Sanctuary with over 500 rescued animals, most roam free. We have 3 of a planned 10 anti-bullying children’s books that we take to schools with some of the friendly animals at the Funny Farm. We teach kids that despite our differences, we can all get along like the animals of the Funny Farm. 

Please check us out on Facebook for true and inspirational stories of the Funny Farm animals under...

“Funny Farm Rescue”

We are also on Instagram. 

No appointment is necessary. Anyone can volunteer at any age. If you are under 15, just bring an adult with you. You can volunteer any Sunday or Tuesday any time between 8-4pm. 

We have hayrides!!!

We hope you will come see us very soon!
